name: Shell Cells
detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

You have no name. You have no past. You only know one thing — you're trapped.
Welcome within The Void.

In this story-rich psychological horror experience, you awaken in a world that defies logic — an eerie, formless space filled with shifting walls and distant whispers. You don’t know how you got here. You don’t know who you are. But one thing is clear: something is watching... and it remembers you.

Enter the Shell Cells

Navigate a hauntingly surreal series of environments known as Shell Cells — twisted, empty constructs left behind by the mind of Sezhar, a once-living being now consumed by isolation. She died five years ago... and her grief shaped this place. Now she lingers here, fractured and desperate to reclaim her identity — even if it means tearing yours apart.

A World Without Familiarity

Nothing in The Void is as it seems. Memories fade. Objects distort. Rooms breathe. With every step deeper into Sezhar’s psyche, the world becomes more uncanny — warped reflections of reality where everything feels just a bit... off. Grayscale tones bleed into your senses, robbing comfort from every shadow.

Features

  • 🧠 Psychological Horror – Experience dread not only through jumpscares, but through atmosphere, emotion, and breathtaking voice acting.

  • 🕯️ Story-Rich Exploration – Piece together the truth behind Sezhar, The Void, and your role within it.

  • 🧩 Surreal Environments – Explore the Shell Cells, each one more distorted and emotionally charged than the last.

  • 🔍 Unreliable Reality – Perception is fragile. What you see may not be real. What you hear might be something inside you.

  • 🎧 Immersive Sound Design – 3D audio and a haunting original score draw you deep into the madness.

Will you escape The Void...
…or become a part of it?

short_description: Trapped in a shifting, surreal world shaped by grief, uncover Sezhar's identity and survive the psychological horror of The Void. Explore haunting environments, question reality, and face a presence that remembers you… even if you don’t.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Latest drivers for AMD and NVIDIA are recommended.
